description:
Lauma is a playable Dendro character in Genshin Impact .

As the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions , Lauma is a well-respected and wise figure within the group, and trusted by all manners of wildlife. She is immeasurably kind and seeks to find a calm resolution to any conflict; though her steel will reveal itself should people mistake her benevolence for acquiescence.
role_summary: Lauma is a Dendro support character who enables her party members to trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions and enhances Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions. After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill , she summons a Frostgrove Sanctuary, which deals continuous Dendro DMG to opponents and lowers their Dendro and Hydro RES. After Lauma uses her Elemental Burst , she grants nearby party members a fixed number of Pale Hymn stacks, which increase the Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom DMG dealt.

talents.name: Peregrination of Linnunrata
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Dendro DMG Charged Attack Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps. When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time. Plunging Attack Calling upon the might of Dendro, Lauma plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.

talents.name: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko
talents.description: Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a Frostgrove Sanctuary Frostgrove Sanctuary A magical array that protects the Moonchanters and can be summoned by using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko. The Frostgrove Sanctuary will follow the active character, dealing a single instance of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents within the array every 2s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG. with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold. Tap Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG . Hold Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 Verdant Dew Verdant Dew When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource. Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset. . Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of Moon Song Moon Song A mel...

talents.name: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon
talents.description: Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of Pale Hymn Pale Hymn A hymn passed down by generations of Moonchanters that increases the DMG dealt by Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions. Lauma can gain Pale Hymn stacks in the following ways: When using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon. When consuming Moon Song stacks due to using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon. When the Frostgrove Sanctuary triggers the effect of her Constellation "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight". When party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit. The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently. . Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has Moon Song Moon Song A melody used to weave together hymns. talents.name: Light for the Frosty Night
talents.description: For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko , corresponding differing buff effects will be granted depending on the party 's Moonsign. The buffs provided by different Moonsign levels cannot stack. Moonsign: Nascent Gleam Bloom , Hyperbloom , and Burgeon DMG dealt by all nearby party members can score CRIT Hits , with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%.

talents.name: Cleansing for the Spring
talents.description: Each point of Elemental Mastery Lauma has will give her the following bonuses: DMG dealt by her Elemental Skill is increased by 0.04%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 32%. The cooldown of her Charged Attack Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is reduced by 0.02%. The maximum reduction obtainable this way is 20%.

talents.name: Nature's Chorus
talents.description: When a Bloom reaction is triggered by a party member, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Lauma has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%. Additionally, when Lauma is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery . This effect can be triggered once every 1.9s. Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s.
